messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need a short PRD for committed capacity overage behavior. Customer asks are coming from 3 accounts asking how overages are billed when Dedicated pools hit commit and burst finals. Need scope, acceptance criteria, and a tidy API/UI change.

mira: +1. Do we want hard caps, soft caps with auto-bill, or a hybrid where customers opt-in to overage?

alex: Prefer hybrid. Default soft cap with explicit opt-out to hard cap. Goal: predictable economics for enterprise customers and simple defaults for self-serve.

jonathan: Edge cases to call out: model fallback (if preferred model unavailable, route to cheaper variant), multi-tenant pooling, and rollover credits from previous period. Also need to specify rounding and per-token vs per-request semantics.

sam: For API surface: expose per-tenant quota object + billing mode. Sketch:```json
{
  "quota_mode": "soft|hard",
  "commit_units": 1000000,
  "burst_units": 200000,
  "overage_price_per_unit": "0.0002",
  "billing_window": "monthly|enterprise-commit"
}
```

mira: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) UI shows current commit, used, and projected overage cost in Console route. 2) API returns clear headers for remaining commit and next-billing estimate. 3) If hard cap and exceeded -> 429 with friendly error and billing link. 4) Soft cap allowed -> continue serving and generate detailed invoice line items. 5) Canary rollout to Dedicated customers only for first month.

alex: Also add: regression test coverage for burst smoothing (ensure autoscaler doesn't create phantom overage). And perf SLO: adding quota checks mustn't add >5ms p99 to request path.

jonathan: Edge-case: simultaneous spike across regions leading to double-counting if replication lag. Spec should require idempotent usage-attribution and a canonical aggregator per-tenant. Add acceptance test: simulated cross-region spike shouldn't create >1% double-billing.

sam: UI acceptance notes: place a small inline estimator on model-selection modal: "Estimated monthly spend at current rates" and a link to commit/opt-in flow. Keep UX small — avoid a new deep page for MVP.

alex: Prioritization: MVP scope = API + Console estimator + server-side enforcement for hard cap + billing ledger lines. Stretch = per-model pricing, rollover credits, complex routing rules.

mira: Questions for finance/legal: 1) minimum notice for contract changes? 2) how to show prorated refunds? pinging @billing-bot for costing calc.

billing-bot: Automated: projected overage price calc complete. For sample commit 1,000,000 tokens with overage 10%, estimated extra = $200. See /internal/calc/1769993337.

alex: Next steps: mira to draft PRD sketch (1 page) with acceptance criteria by EOD Thu; sam to wire a tiny Console mock; jonathan to draft enforcement design (consistency, aggregator). We'll review Fri 10am.

mira: I'll include example API responses and error codes. Will flag any scope creep. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll mock the estimator in Figma quickframe and drop link.

jonathan: I'll add a simple sequence diagram for attribution + aggregator and include a fallback consistent-read window.

alex: Great. If anyone has strong objections to defaulting to soft cap opt-in hybrid, raise now. Otherwise, PRD goes ahead. :rocket:
